 The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has announced the examination dates for the Engineering Services Examination (ESE) 2027. The Preliminary Examination will be held on January 31, 2027, followed by the Main Examination on June 18, 2027.
 ADVERTISEMENT Candidates who have registered for the examination can access the detailed timetable through the commission's official website, upsc.gov.in .
 The ESE is conducted to recruit candidates to Group A and Group B engineering posts in various departments of the Central government. The selection process consists of three stages: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination and Personality Test.
 Also Read: UPSC declares civil services (main) examination 2026 results UPSC ESE 2027: Preliminary Examination pattern 
 The Preliminary Examination, the first stage of the selection process, will comprise two papers carrying a total of 500 marks.
 The General Studies and Engineering Aptitude paper will carry 200 marks, while the second paper, based on the candidate's chosen engineering discipline, will carry 300 marks.
 The examination will be conducted across four engineering disciplines: Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering.
 Also Read: UPSC CDS I 2026 final result out; 243 candidates recommended for three defence academies Candidates who qualify in the Preliminary Examination will be eligible to appear for the Main Examination.
 Admit card and result dates 
 UPSC is expected to release the admit cards for the Preliminary Examination in January 2027, ahead of the test. However, the commission has not announced a specific release date.
 The preliminary results are expected to be declared in March 2027. The exact date of result announcement is yet to be confirmed.
 Candidates are advised to check the official website for updates on admit cards, results and other examination-related announcements.
 Also Read: UPSC CDS II 2026 admit card released for September 13 exam; check details How to check the UPSC ESE 2027 examination schedule 
 Candidates can follow these steps to download the examination timetable:
 Visit the official UPSC website, upsc.gov.in .
 Go to the 'What's New' or 'Examination Notices' section.
 Look for the notification related to the Engineering Services Examination 2027.
 Click on the notification link to open the examination schedule.
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference.
